name: Neo Angelique: Tenshi no Namida
original_name: ネオ アンジェリーク 天使の涙
source:
The protagonist and her comrades have gone their separate ways. She has chosen to resume her human life by graduating from Melrose Girls Academy. The protagonist reunites with her comrades at Brook Villa once she enrolls into Caldina University two years after defeating Erebos. Two major events have since occurred in Arcadia: a sharp population increase and mysterious monster attacks. As the protagonist investigates them, her choices shall affect the fate of the cosmos and her friends around her.

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Neo_Angelique_Tenshi_no_Namida]Koei Wikia[/url]]
translation:
主人公与同伴们各奔东西。她决定从梅尔罗斯女子学院毕业，重新开始人类生活。击败厄瑞玻斯两年后，主人公进入卡尔迪纳大学，并在布鲁克别墅与同伴重聚。此后，阿尔卡迪亚发生了两件大事：人口急剧增加，以及神秘的怪物袭击。主人公着手调查这些事件，而她的选择将影响宇宙以及身边同伴的命运。

[来源：[url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Neo_Angelique_Tenshi_no_Namida]Koei Wikia[/url]]
